Error.description: A refusal, in the common error shape.

Account.description: The account the service runs as, and whether the desktop's password is kept.

keptPassword.description: Whether `desktop.password` is set and not empty.

name.description: The account's name, which the terminal and the desktop are reached as.

Health.description: Whether the service is ready, why not where it is not, and its version.

ready.description: The store is open and the service answers.

reason.description: Why it is not ready; null while it is.

Terminal.description: One terminal session of the service's tmux server.

createdAt.description: When it began, in epoch milliseconds.

id.description: The session's id: `t-` and lower-case letters and digits.

title.description: What a person names it, empty where it has no name.

TerminalPage.description: A page of terminal sessions, in the order they began.

more.description: Whether anything stands past the last item.

TerminalPaste.description:
The body of `POST /terminals/{terminalId}/pastes`: a picture pasted into the session, its media type and its
bytes in base64.

TerminalPasted.description: Where a pasted picture was kept: the file's absolute path on the machine the session runs on.

TerminalRename.description: The body of `PATCH /terminals/{terminalId}`: the name the session takes, an empty one taking it away.

TerminalRequest.description: The body of `POST /terminals`: the name the new session takes, where one is given.

TerminalState.description:
Where a terminal session stands in its life. The list holds the sessions that stand, so every member it
answers is `running`; an ended session is gone from the list.

WireError.description:
A failure, in the common error shape: the kebab-case code a caller matches on, and the English sentence
for a log.
